server/internal/cli/cli.go.reason: Admin reset command deletes from a fixed allowlisted table set.

server/internal/integrations/thirdparty/.reason: Third-party account queries are static, but migration must preserve account row projection and secret-store lookups as one repository change.

server/internal/logging/repository.go.reason: Management log list and cursor-boundary queries compose optional filters and variable IN clauses; static insert, detail, and pruning queries use sqlc.

server/internal/permission/checker.go.reason: Blacklist, whitelist, and whitelist-state CRUD are static, but they must migrate together to keep one governance repository boundary.

server/internal/plugins/pluginstore/conf.reason: Plugin config selective reads compose a variable key IN clause; namespace-wide reads and writes use sqlc.

server/internal/plugins/pluginstore/kv.g.reason: Plugin KV prefix listing uses SQLite LIKE ESCAPE syntax that sqlc v1.31.1 cannot parse.

server/internal/render/repository/load.g.reason: Render template load and existence queries are static, but they must migrate with the package's revision and transaction query set.

server/internal/render/repository/reposi.reason: Render template cleanup composes variable template and plugin ID NOT IN clauses; static validation and delete-all queries use sqlc.

server/internal/render/repository/querie.reason: Render template list and version queries are static, but they must migrate with the package's shared row projections and transaction queries.

server/internal/render/repository/sql.go.reason: Render template transaction queries are static, but migration must keep the repository's save, revision, validation, and sync operations on one sqlc transaction boundary.

server/internal/storage/integrity.go.reason: Storage integrity uses SQLite PRAGMA quick_check.

server/internal/storage/snapshot.go.reason: Storage snapshot uses PRAGMA setup and VACUUM INTO maintenance SQL.

server/internal/storage/store.go.reason: Storage lifecycle runs WAL checkpoint maintenance.

server/internal/storage/store_open.go.reason: Storage open configures SQLite PRAGMA settings.

server/internal/storage/store_schema.go.reason: Storage migration runner executes schema files, records migrations, and inspects SQLite schema metadata.
